Thanks again for the call today 

Great to meet the FinLytics team. Quick recap and next steps so we all have the same plan:

- What we learned: you want streaming embeddings + a reranker for semantic search on nightly batch ingest (10k docs), and low-latency product search for query-time calls.
- Current blocking item: infra reported intermittent 5xx responses from Redwood when running larger batches for embeddings + reranker. They saw it spike around 500-1k concurrent embed requests during the ingest window.

Immediate next steps (owners):
- Dev (cc) to triage 5xx and provide repro guidance + recommended timeouts / retry policy.
- Camila to share SDK integration notes and sample config for streaming + structured tool-calls.
- Marissa to coordinate POA and share MAP + hubspot link.

Thanks Marissa 

Appreciate the recap. Phil (infra) attached the log snippet showing the 502/503s and a short note on when they happened (attached as error_log.txt).

A few clarifications:
- Batch job: we kick off 10k documents in parallel shards; embedding calls are made in batches of 256. Reranker is a separate call per query during indexing.
- SDK: currently on the JS SDK v0.9 via a server-side Node worker; we authenticate via a bearer token with scope "inference:embed".
- We see 5xx mostly when embedding batch size >= 128 and when multiple shards hit at the same time (spike to 800-1k QPS).

Can Dev share the minimum repro payload you need? We can paste the exact request body.

Thanks,
Sarah

Thanks for the log, Sarah. Initial triage notes:

- 502/503 pattern suggests a backend timeout or an upstream worker crash during the heavy batch window.
- Helpful repro items for us: exact request payload (one example full JSON), SDK version + client config (timeout, maxSockets), and a small curl example that reproduces the issue.

Quick suggestions you can try immediately:
1) Reduce requested batch size to 64 or 32 for the large nightly ingest and see whether error rate drops.
2) Increase client-side timeout to 90s for embed batch calls and add backoff retries (exponential, 3 attempts).
3) If using the JS SDK, set maxConcurrentRequests to 10 and enable streaming=false for embedding ingestion jobs.

If you can drop a single payload and the sdk_version file, we can run a repro in our staging infra.

I'll follow up with a short curl sample in my next email.

- Dev
Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-call: FinLytics integration: embed+reranker 5xx during batch ingest

Thanks for the payload, team. Quick ML-side notes after a glance at request_payload.json:

- Embedding request body looks fine but batch_size=256 + concurrent shards explains memory pressure on the query workers (large KV cache + long seqs). Reranker calls are synchronous and may cascade when embed workers slow down.

Suggested temporary mitigations (to validate while we investigate deeper):
- Drop batch_size to 64 for the nightly ingest (should reduce peak memory and per-request CPU).
- Set client timeout to 90s and retries=3 with exponential backoff (initial 500ms).
- Use quantized model variant for batch embedding jobs (we can recommend a profile; Camila can share config).
- For reranker, switch to asynchronous queueing: write rerank requests to a lightweight queue and throttle to 50 TPS.

I'll spin up a repro in our staging cluster using your payload and the SDK notes and post findings in INF-3221.

-Neha
Applied ML, Redwood Inference

   - FinLytics: increase client timeout to 90s and enable retries=3 (ACTION: FinLytics infra)

2) Redwood triage (owner: Dev)
   - Run repro in staging with attached payload and SDK v0.9.1. Capture full request/response traces and correlate with worker logs. Create INF-3221 and link logs.
